name: crown-molding-simple
description: IXT-SUITES back-fill for the crownMolding feature (tier:simple, default:true — a core finish detail baked into every full-height wall face, not a user-facing panel toggle). Verifies the flag defaults ON in both Simple and Pro (tier:simple is never forced off by resolveFlags), then renders the trim at a full-height wall-ceiling seam (livingDining east wall, wall-ext-E, which has no window/door cutouts so its whole span sits at ceiling height). Paints the wall a bold navy so the fixed off-white crown colour (#eeece6, same regardless of wall finish) has contrast against the paint, then toggles the flag off/on/off-cleanup via setFeatureFlag to prove the strip is flag-driven (on/off/restored screenshots at the same fixed camera). Each store-only mutation is followed by a tiny setManualHour nudge to force a new render burst — see the 'demand-frameloop presentation can lag one render burst behind' gotcha in the visual-verification playbook.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); })()
